info.title: Machine User API
info.description: API for machine-to-machine integrations. Authenticate using the x-machine-user-client-id and authorization headers.

post.description: Currently only supports upload of offer documents. the processId can be obtained from the response of the create request endpoint

post.description:
To create a request, follow these steps:
    1. get your tenantId and legalEntityId ready. these should be known ahead of time.
    2. list the available burial forms and choose one.
    3. list the available products and choose which to include in the request including the quantity. these are the 'items'
    4. pass the information on the deceased person and the client in the respective fields.
    5. optionally gather the grave type and legal entity branch information from their respective endpoints.
    6. use the upload document endpoint to upload the corresponding pdf document if needed.

get.description:
Lists the tenant's product categories. Categories are tenant-wide and not legal-entity-specific; the legalEntityId
in the path only scopes authorization (the machine user must hold the offer-configurator role on that legal entity),
it does not filter the categories. Use the returned category ids with the products endpoint's categoryIds query
parameter to filter products.

Redirects (Location header) to a short-lived URL for the original document file. Released to machine users to fetch
product images: pass the product's image documentAccessToken as the x-access-token query parameter and send the
x-machine-user-client-id header. The access token is short-lived (one day); re-fetch the product list to obtain a
fresh token once it expires.

Redirects (Location header) to a short-lived URL for a document preview/thumbnail, falling back to the original file
when no separate preview exists (e.g. for uploaded images). Released to machine users to render product-image
thumbnails: pass the product's image documentAccessToken as the x-access-token query parameter and send the
x-machine-user-client-id header. The access token is short-lived (one day); re-fetch the product list to obtain a
fresh token once it expires.

ProductImage.description:
Metadata of the product image. Fetch the actual image with the documentAccessToken against
GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/documents/{documentId}/preview?x-access-token={documentAccessToken}
(preview) or .../file (original). The access token is short-lived (valid for one day); re-fetch the
product list to obtain a fresh token once it expires.

CustomerPortalLegalLinksMissing.description: The legal entity's privacy and imprint links are both mandatory as soon as its customer portal configuration holds any content. The booleans tell which of the two is missing.

machineUserClientSecret.description: Machine user client secret, sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header
